captions.detailed: A realistic, modern air purifier with a tall, rectangular light-gray body featuring rounded corners and tapered upper edges. On its flat top surface, there is a circular black control dial and a small rectangular button. One side of the lower body features an integrated, slightly protruding rectangular filter access door, while the opposite side has a dark, recessed venting panel.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic, highly detailed air purifier with a clean, light-gray appliance body, a dark venting surface, a matching filter access door, and black top-mounted controls including a circular dial and a small button.
captions.factory: Construct the main body by extruding a rounded rectangle, shelling it, and tapering the top portion. Create the filter door as a separate thin plate attached to the lower side. Model the top controls using a cylinder for the rotary dial and a small box for the button. Apply a light-gray material to the main body and filter door, and a contrasting dark/black material to the controls and venting surface.
